summary: RAG draft + embedding coverage-gap repair call
hypothesis: Keeping exp003's strong 6/7 draft questions untouched and making only one surgical FM call to patch the single least-covered slot should improve coverage without risking the rest of the draft — because moving the coverage judgment into deterministic Swift embeddings removes fallible 3B judgment from the loop.
technique: A RAG pipeline generates the base draft from the 2 nearest exemplars; Swift NLEmbedding then identifies the gold unknown least covered by the draft and the most-redundant draft slot; a single focused FM call adapts that gold question into the redundant slot, leaving 6/7 questions untouched.

stages.text: Fetch 2 nearest gold exemplars via RAG
Swift NLEmbedding: find gap + redundant slot
One FM call: adapt gold Q into redundant slot
